question: Does globally assigned context correction, applied only to private incidence generators of a shared learned NSD body, improve restored full-input predictive ensembling beyond ordinary context augmentation and competent independent encoders?
representative_task: Ordinary Tolokers, complete graph, official split0: original benchmark exploratory comparison, not an unused task/confirmation
prerequisites: Complete current full-task native-single/feature-MLP competence screen and selected-state reconstruction; no competence assumed here
Freeze one competent native architecture and one competent feature-only teacher per replicate using the predeclared full-validation rule
Use authentic official TRAIN/VALID roles; TEST truth, metrics and plots remain unopened to the experiment
Qualify any new auxiliary capture/gradient-routing implementation before scientific runs; existing frozen/live packets unchanged

fixed.teacher: Restored frozen feature-only MLP from ordinary baseline for the paired replicate; same TRAIN truth, no extra labels
fixed.optimizer: Same frozen original Adam/lr/decay rules; no new grid
fixed.queries: 64 disjoint TRAIN queries, 32 per class via prospectively fixed hash, removed from context source sets
fixed.patches: Four deterministic balanced graph patches from canonical unlabelled support; evidence source A_k=P_k intersect TRAIN minus Q
fixed.view: Retain feature rows only for A_k; other rows zero; complete static support and original native math
fixed.eligibility: Q_k uses graph distance<=frozen layers; reject representative design if any context has<8 queries or either class absent, without post-fit repairs
fixed.allocation: One global four-by-four balanced assignment from warmup TRAIN context J scores; freeze thereafter, deterministic hashed ties
fixed.serving: All members see original complete input; mean native probabilities. Teacher/context views are training-only
fixed.selection: Full original-input VALID AUROC only; save/reconstruct selected state; auxiliary context scores never select checkpoints/strength/patches

shared_model_ownership.theta: All native stem, feature maps, slow incidence weights, epsilons and head shared by identity; learned from full-task mean own NLL only
shared_model_ownership.eta: Persistent private r/s factors only on ordered incidence learners at every layer; full-task and contrast gradients; all current member trajectories remain private
shared_model_ownership.auxiliary_gradient: mean_m J_m, apply only to eta (theta and teacher constant); retain recurrence/state paths into eta
shared_model_ownership.independent_gradient: Each genuine complete encoder/head/geometry has separate weights and own optimizer; unscaled original NLL. For matched auxiliary opportunity apply the same J to its own incidence-generator parameters while its own feature/head parameters receive original own NLL; no common encoder/pooled-optimizer substitute

minimal_paired_stage.auxiliary: J=CE(softmax(log teacher + (native context logits - analytic zero-message logits)),TRAIN labels)

Ordinary CE on native context predictions, weighted by frozen teacher error probability 1-r(y_q|x_q); same fixed lambda, queries, masked views, teacher, geometry-only recipient, full-input F and selected warmup assignment
minimal_paired_stage.allocation: exact same frozen assignment/starting warmup checkpoint as paired candidate

minimal_paired_stage.purpose: Whether learning global evidence ownership adds anything
minimal_paired_stage.allocation: fixed hash permutation of the same four contexts; same global/per-member view and label counts

minimal_paired_stage.purpose: Competent ordinary ensemble with same context/label opportunity
minimal_paired_stage.auxiliary: same context contrast, teacher, eligibility and one auxiliary path/member; geometry-generator recipient only
minimal_paired_stage.allocation: same balancing procedure and fixed context inventory; complete fresh encoders, heads and separate native optimizers
minimal_paired_stage.serving: own selected full-input checkpoints and mean probabilities

ordinary_references: Competent native single and feature-only MLP from the frozen complete-task screen
Shared geometry-only four-member bank with regularizer off
Genuine independent native ensemble with original own losses and restored checkpoints; do not infer competence from the matched context arm alone
paired_information_and_cost: All main models use every TRAIN label and the same complete input/support; views and teacher introduce no new truth
Paired shared comparison starts from the same 100-epoch F-only warmup state and identical frozen global context assignment, so contrast vs ordinary augmentation is the manipulated operation
Independent encoders receive identical context/label opportunity and separately qualified own supervision; parameter/capacity differences remain explicit
Auxiliary arms use exactly one complete native context forward/member per post-warmup step; cached static topology and feature masks, analytic zero-message reference, no dense graph diagnostic
Charge full native paths, map generation/normalization/SVD, sparse multiplication/backwards, extra context paths, optimizer/teacher storage and measured wall/peak memory

A regularizer-off reference performs less training work; if a claimed benefit could be paid extra stochastic supervision, run the predeclared same-work F-only second-draw mean-own-NLL control before making that claim, with one optimizer step and same max epoch budget

close_prior_gate_before_a_broad_claim.reason: Verified shared network/private sampled sheaf/predictive ensemble collision. Preserve its inspected input-conditioned incidence-factorized family, likelihood/KL objective and stated layer sampling; qualify licensed faithful implementation rather than calling a weak native proxy BSNN.

close_prior_gate_before_a_broad_claim.control: State-conditioned structured global-latent sheaf sampler with the exact same context contrast
close_prior_gate_before_a_broad_claim.reason: Global correlated modes and state feedback are existing representation extensions; matching means persistent BE factors are not uniquely required. Declare extension/operator/MC/KL changes and matched serving paths.

close_prior_gate_before_a_broad_claim.control: Single native predictor receiving the same four context tasks, plus competent joint four-transport readout
close_prior_gate_before_a_broad_claim.reason: If a single decision rule recovers quality/cost, context augmentation or multiple geometries suffice without finite committee pooling.

close_prior_gate_before_a_broad_claim.control: Flat/node-frame or layer-shared transport with matched private node capacity; feature/head-private matched-budget contrast
close_prior_gate_before_a_broad_claim.reason: If recovered, operator/geometry ownership is explained by node/frame adaptation or induced geometry from private states. No gauge-inequivalent connection claim.

decision_rules: Primary comparison is full-input VALID pooled AUROC with per-member mean/best quality and NLL/Brier secondary; report every paired seed

After checkpoint selection, measure actual VALID context prediction/correction using the fixed TRAIN source sets and new VALID queries, without using those scores for tuning; no raw matrix-spread evidence is requested
If selected checkpoint precedes contrast activation, record that no steering was tested
Require benefit beyond ordinary context/teacher-hardness control, random ownership and competent independent context ensemble before attributing global corrective specialization
Stop the extension if context TRAIN skill grows without restored original-input quality or context transfer, or if original member competence deteriorates without collective recovery

Even positive paired pilot evidence supplies no priority, Bayesian validity, broad superiority or fresh confirmation; resolve close-prior gates and a separately audited confirmation task before broader claims
